name: ui-math-canvas
description: MathCanvas — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui math-canvas pattern).

schema.name: ui-math-canvas
schema.description: MathCanvas — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui math-canvas pattern).

events.name: Update
events.description: Live scene update; payload carries the current drawable state.

backgroundColor.label: Background Color
backgroundColor.description: Canvas fill color; `var(--token, fallback)` strings resolve against the active theme. Default transparent.

keyUpMap.label: Key Up Map
keyUpMap.description: Maps a keyup `e.code` → the board's SEMANTIC event.

showCurveLabels.label: Show Curve Labels
showCurveLabels.description: Draw each curve's `label` at its last in-range sample (default false).

gridColor.label: Grid Color
gridColor.description: Grid line color; resolves theme tokens (default `var(--color-border, #9ca3af)`).

readouts.label: Readouts
readouts.description: Top-right status chips, forwarded verbatim to LearningCanvas.

axisColor.label: Axis Color
axisColor.description: Axis line color; resolves theme tokens (default `var(--color-muted-foreground, #374151)`).

regions.label: Regions
regions.description: Filled areas under curves or between curve pairs.

keyMap.label: Key Map
keyMap.description: Maps a keydown `e.code` → the board's SEMANTIC event (device-agnostic input), emitted as `UI:{event}` — same contract as the game canvas keyMap.

shapes.label: Shapes
shapes.description: Extra declarative shapes in canvas pixel coordinates.

traces.label: Traces
traces.description: Inset sparkline panels, forwarded verbatim to LearningCanvas.

showTickLabels.label: Show Tick Labels
showTickLabels.description: Draw numeric labels on grid lines (default false).
